label: PF Backlog 77
title: Backend API: run/read model-capability fit (tier-level + per-agent/model)
body:
Expose the model-capability-fit to the dashboard: POST /api/model-fit/run (probe the selected tier's models vs agent requirements; returns the report; body may pass {tier, apply:bool}); GET /api/model-fit?project= (last report + applied substitutions); GET /api/model-fit/agent/?project= (that agent's model compatibility + recommendation). Backed by core/model_fit.py + products/

/model-fit.json. Actions routed through core (no store writes from the API layer). Refs: BI-0076.
